name: v1_default
_comment_models: The 30 TabArena-native models onboarded/wired this session (16 previously-listed-but-unwired, fixed in 5c57fe4, plus 14 newly onboarded in 3 batches: 98c44ad/90f49a8/a6a6986), all confirmed to resolve cleanly via raman_bench.models.registry.infer_model_cls as of 0388978 -- see cluster-agent's rollout notes. PLS is listed LAST, not first: pick_chunk() picks the FIRST model in this list with a nonempty backlog and takes a full chunk_size from it before ever looking at the next model (strict priority, not round-robin) -- PLS already has a large in-progress backlog from its long head start, so putting it first would starve all 30 new models of any new submissions until PLS's backlog was fully drained. PLS's own already-queued/running SLURM tasks are unaffected by this ordering (only NEW chunk submissions go through pick_chunk); this only governs which model gets NEW work first going forward. Deliberately excludes: AUTOGLUON (whole-predictor meta-preset, not a per-model ConfigGenerator -- can't be wired into run_experiment.py's one-model-per-job design as-is); the 11 pre-existing RamanBench-native custom architectures (ARSENAL, COATNET, DEEPCNN, FCRESNEXT, GBM, RAMANFORMER, RAMANNET, RAMANTRANSFORMER, REZERONET, ROCKET, SANET) and TABPFN-WIDE -- these were NOT part of this session's TabArena-onboarding/smoke-testing effort, models.json (the project's own 'real-benchmark-ready-under-v1' tracking file) still lists only PLS, and TABPFN-WIDE was explicitly removed from this very file in e726176 (still resolves in Python because infer_model_cls reads the live PREPROCESSED_MODELS registry, not this file -- resolvability alone was never sufficient, see the whole point of 5c57fe4). Adding any of these needs its own explicit go-ahead, not a rider on this change.
_comment_model_time_limit_overrides: EBM's real TimeLimitExceeded on wide datasets was mostly interpret's own O(n_features^2) interaction-ranking pre-scan (see Prep_EBM._fit's docstring) -- fixed at the model level (interactions=0 above 4000 features), not by budget alone. A real calibration run post-fix (microgel_synthesis, 11084 features, run_experiment.py --model EBM --time-limit 900 --num-bag-folds 8, auto-scaled to 2 effective folds for this 14-row dataset) finished in 426s wall time (400s training), already well inside the 3600s default. These 5400s entries are headroom, not a required fix: the other 9 targets in the same 11084-11689-feature cluster have more rows and so use the full 8 bag folds (not 2), extrapolating to roughly 4x -> ~1700s -- 5400s leaves >3x margin over that for a slower cluster CPU than the one calibrated on. ORIONMSP's pharmaceutical_ingredients entry is similarly a safety margin, not the primary fix -- see cluster/profiles/htw.yaml's ORIONMSP mem_tier: a real local run there (2 bag folds) finished fitting in ~175s but then crashed from memory (~25-27GB RSS on a 36GB machine), i.e. this dataset's real confirmed risk is memory, not time.
